title: Kagamine Rin — Unfamiliar Versions Of Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, my throat is all warmed up♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Time to sing a lot again today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm?
I thought I heard someone call my name.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did it come from over there?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There it is again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All the voices are different, and they're calling in different ways, but they all sound so familiar...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Maybe they're each calling the me from their SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, there's no way I could hear them so clearly when I'm not even watching the SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ack!
Oh, it's a fragment of a feeling. You startled me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Over there, too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, they're all over the place!
Why are there so many gathered here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does it have anything to do with all those voices I heard?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I don't really know...
But let's see what happens when I touch these feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: W-Where am I?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is so cool!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, it's like an art museum in here! What are all these cubes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They look like they should fall over, but they're stuck together... Ah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: These look like photos, and they're all showing me from each different SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Plus...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I knew it! I can feel their emotions!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, all those fragments of feelings that were gathered up must be their feelings toward the version of me from each SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wonder how they feel...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If I touch these photos, maybe I'll be able to find out?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm, which one should I touch?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Look how brightly the performer me is smiling here. I wonder why she's so happy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll just have a quick little peek!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: ——Rin, do you have a minute?
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ah, Nene♪
What is it☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Remember when you said, “you just need a big smile, and your voice will feel happier and you'll sparkle even more”?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I know I need more practice singing...
But would you mind helping me practice my smile, too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
Leave it to me♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Ah! Shhh!
I-I don't want the others to overhear...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! It'll be our secret♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, how should we practice?
Want me to poke your cheeks again? Or should I tickle you and make you laugh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?! I thought you would just show me how you do it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Right, Nene asked that SEKAI's me for help with her smile, to sparkle brighter.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I see...
So they practiced in secret after that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Performer me smiles so brightly that sometimes even I get dazzled.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: With her smile to learn from, I bet everyone else will also be able to smile just as bright!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah! Speaking of sparkly smiles...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There she is! Idol me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This shows the cake and marzipan dolls Airi made for us on Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll just take a little peek in here, too♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that the surprise is done, let's have some cake.
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, Airi!
I want to look at the dolls some more.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, um... Could you and the others start with the slices that don't have any of them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, I don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin seems really taken with those little marzipan figures.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. The highest praise an artist can receive!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially since Rin is always there for us. I'm happy to give back to her, even a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right! Even after the cake was all gone, idol me kept looking at those marzipan dolls.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She did finally end up mustering the courage to eat them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I totally understand why she wanted to just keep them forever!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Their outfits and expressions were so detailed, it looked like they might start singing and dancing right there!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm glad Airi was smiling so happily too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still... They look like ordinary photos, but when I touch them, everyone's feelings come rushing in.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I guess this really is a collection of feelings toward all the SEKAI versions of me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm curious about some of these others... Maybe I'll look at a few more emotions.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's see, next is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! This one!
